justiceSays.line: ★ IDENTIFIED: Pokeweed. Smooth stalks, purple-red stems, dark berry clusters. Uses unknown — harvest, taste, and learn.
★ IDENTIFIED: Poison Hemlock. Tall white umbels on smooth stems blotched purple. Uses unknown — harvest, taste, and learn.
Word reaches you, days late: Rodrigo stands accused over what happened to Thabo. There's going to be a moot. People are choosing sides.
Word reaches you, days late: Rodrigo stands accused over what happened to Thabo. There's going to be a moot. People are choosing sides.
Thabo has been talking at the fires. Enough voices — tonight they call a moot. Rodrigo answers for what happened to Thabo.
Thabo calls the moot. The fire gets built up — word travels fast, and almost everyone comes.
The moot turns to you. Your vote matters here — and everyone will remember it.
Rodrigo is gone — the moot doesn't try the dead. The cases die with the accused; the fire remembers the rest.
Word reaches you, days late: Thabo stands accused over what happened to Rodrigo. There's going to be a moot. People are choosing sides.
Seymour has been talking at the fires. Enough voices — tonight they call a moot. Thabo answers for what happened to Rodrigo.
Seymour calls the moot. The fire gets built up — word travels fast, and almost everyone comes.
The moot turns to you. Your vote matters here — and everyone will remember it.
The moot doesn't wait forever. Two days of silence from the fire's edge — the count is taken without you.
The fire is built high. Nobody speaks while the count is taken — you can hear the wind past the edge of the light.
Debbie counts on their fingers, twice, like they don't trust the first number. Then, to the fire: "0 for guilty. 6 against."
A long exhale moves around the fire like weather. "Not guilty — this time."
They're named, every one: Marcus Garcia, Tariq Fischer, Cole Nakamura. Your move — ask them questions (up to three), call a MOOT on it, or turn them away at the edge of the firelight.
They waited three days at the edge of your fire. Nobody called the moot. Marcus nods — not angry, just done — and they walk.
They're named, every one: Tomás Murphy. Your move — ask them questions (up to three), call a MOOT on it, or turn them away at the edge of the firelight.
They waited three days at the edge of your fire. Nobody called the moot. Tomás nods — not angry, just done — and they walk.

Emberhold watches to see if Haven holds without its dead. The bond is young — they're still deciding what Haven is, and grief delays the verdict. They'll test the link — count on it, unless Haven answers first: send grain (1,500 kcal), send a speaker (2 days), or let the silence answer. (Trust -8.)

Fatima leans in, voice low. "Here's what we figured out about Lockpick. Buy it off. It steals FIRST and fights second — but it CANNOT resist food. OFFER FOOD in the fight: it drops your things mid-scamper for the meal. A bribe is cheaper than a chase."

💡 COUNTER LEARNED — Lockpick: Buy it off. It steals FIRST and fights second — but it CANNOT resist food. OFFER FOOD in the fight: it drops your things mid-scamper for the meal. A bribe is cheaper than a chase. (Someone at the haven knew the trick.)
📓 Codex: Counter: Buy it off — It steals FIRST and fights second — but it CANNOT resist food. OFFER FOOD in the fight: it drops your things mid-scamper for the meal. A bribe is cheaper than a chase.
